review: Independent stage review: KB import, normalization, merge, persistence, downstream identity/tier

conclusions.evidence: kbNormalizeImported converts genuinely invalid tier 'safety' to 3 and unknown bucket 'Pharm' to Look; safetyCritical stays true; dropped remains zero; validateLatteKnowledgeBase returns [].
conclusions.impact: An import receives plausible but unestablished priority/category; subsequent generation receives those defaults and its tags control tier-scoped exports.
conclusions.restriction: Invalid input does not establish the intended clinical tier or bucket. Do not describe a demonstrated clinically correct Tier 1 fact as demoted. Rejecting invalid input or disclosing its fallback is the justified desired behavior.

conclusions.evidence: Actual merge output retained 4027 fact-text characters; JSON roundtrip through the actual import/reload normalizer retained 4000. 600 quote chars, 50 per-fact pointers, 2000 conditions, 5000 facts/condition are silent caps; dropped is zero and a fully sourced long fact remains validation-clean.
conclusions.impact: Valid source text including a trailing exception and provenance pointers disappear on import/reload without a diagnostic.
conclusions.restriction: Resource limits may be legitimate policy, but silent truncation and unreported omission are independently observable. This probe does not establish effects in actual private KBs.

conclusions.disposition: refuted as an active Anki stale-link defect; retained as snapshot-scope limitation
conclusions.evidence: IDs fact-7/fact-42 become fact-1/fact-2. Actual App setter cleared registry and inspector; actual registerArtifact rejected an old-source publication; actual ankiRunIsCurrent returned false after KB identity changed.
conclusions.downstreamGuards: Anki current flag is batch.sourceKB===K.knowledgeBase (5575); ankiSelection(current=false) yields kept=[] (4360); summary uses current snapshot only (4297); export consumes selection (4474); generated artifacts are session-only (578-582). Fresh generation maps against its own immutable snapshot and chunk IDs (4166-4192).
conclusions.restriction: Saved external evidence must retain its snapshot or content, since fact-N alone is not a cross-import identifier. No persisted Anki map is reattached on page reload.

conclusions.evidence: Source suite confirms copied queued snapshots, order, abort rejection/handle closure, and unresolved different-writer conflicts. Reload reuses the lossy import sanitizer; that loss is included in A2.
conclusions.restriction: Native IndexedDB and browser event interleaving were not executed.

safeguards.name: import size/shape gate
safeguards.availableEvidence: File byte size and parsed JSON only
safeguards.predicate: file.size <=25MiB; object root; conditions array; usable named condition; nonempty fact text
safeguards.effect: oversize or invalid root rejects; malformed entries skipped with dropped counters; cap/coercion changes are not counted
safeguards.error: Import failed displayed and prior KB remains; replacement ownership suppresses stale publication
safeguards.bypass: Generated build does not run this sanitizer until a later import/reload.

safeguards.name: validateLatteKnowledgeBase
safeguards.availableEvidence: Normalized KB values, quote presence, pointer filename strings
safeguards.predicate: name, duplicate IDs, allowed bucket, tier 1..3, text presence; quote missing warns; critical/numeric fact requires filename
safeguards.effect: returns issues only; Anki logs errors as warnings and still generates
safeguards.error: no proof of pointer existence, quote entailment, or correct tier; no prior raw fields remain for fallback detection
safeguards.bypass: Normalizer replaces invalid tier/bucket before validation; any nonempty filename satisfies pointer predicate.

safeguards.name: mergeLatteParts
safeguards.availableEvidence: Raw model condition aliases, text/bucket/subtype, sourcePointer
safeguards.predicate: Conservative condition-name/alias equivalence; fact key uses bucket, subtype and whitespace-collapsed text
safeguards.effect: merges exact-equivalent facts and unions pointers by filename/location; assigns new IDs; invalid tiers fallback to 1 for truthy safetyCritical else 2
safeguards.error: no binding from pointer to actual runtime source; no correction of meaning
safeguards.bypass: Same text with differing source quotes retains first quote while unioning pointers. This is provenance design scope, not independently proved false provenance.

safeguards.name: ordered persistence/recovery
safeguards.availableEvidence: JSON-copied KB, writer lineage, sequence, parent key, fallback bytes
safeguards.predicate: expected durable head/fallback bytes unchanged; reconciliation requires ordering or user choice
safeguards.effect: serial save; snapshots copied at save call; conflicts block saves and retain choices; tombstones prevent stale resurrection
safeguards.error: IDB failure tries fallback; failure of both surfaces visible error; no automatic choice of incompatible copies
safeguards.bypass: Hydration normalizes selected stored KB at 10168; normalization diagnostics discarded there.

safeguards.name: source identity and link lifetime
safeguards.availableEvidence: Live object identity, captured source identity, operation abort signal
safeguards.predicate: registry publication requires current source object; Anki active generation requires active run/current source/not aborted
safeguards.effect: replacement clears registry/inspector; stale run rejected; old notes remain but have no current coverage/export
safeguards.error: no browser race proof here, but actual extracted callbacks confirm guard behavior
safeguards.bypass: No bypass found in reviewed import path; fact IDs alone remain insufficient outside their captured source.
